description: This file defines data models and query parameters for handling SEC Form 13F-HR filings, including classes for query parameters and data representation with validation logic.

classes.name: Form13FHRQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching Form 13F-HR filings, including symbol, date, and limit, with validation to uppercase the symbol.

classes.name: Form13FHRData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for a Form 13F-HR filing, including fields like period ending, issuer, cusip, asset class, security type, and voting authority details, with validation for option type.

methods.name: to_upper
methods.description: Converts the symbol input to uppercase before processing.

methods.name: validate_option_type
methods.description: Validates and converts the option_type field to lowercase if provided.
